scripts.patch:core: cd packages/core && npm version patch $(ls -t builds/*.tgz | head -n 1) --access public
scripts.release:core: cd packages/core && npm publish $(ls -t builds/*.tgz | head -n 1) --access public
scripts.patch:consumer: cd packages/consumer && npm version patch $(ls -t builds/*.tgz | head -n 1) --access public
scripts.release:consumer: cd packages/consumer && npm publish $(ls -t builds/*.tgz | head -n 1) --access public
